metadata.question: Did San Jose have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than Los Angeles from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare average nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentrations between San Jose and Los Angeles from 2018-2019. I need to: 1. Use appropriate NO2 data - Sentinel-5P provides tropospheric NO2 data 2. Define geometries for both cities 3. Handle data quality by checking collection sizes and valid pixels 4. Compare the average NO2 values and determine which is higher For NO2 data, I can use: - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2 - Band: NO2_column_number_density (tropospheric NO2) - Time range: 2018-01-01 to 2019-12-31 I'll define both cities as points with buffers to capture urban areas, then calculate mean NO2 concentrations for comparison. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define city geometries with buffers const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]).buffer(15000); // 15km buffer const losAngeles = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2437, 34.0522]).buffer(15000); // 15km buffer // Time period const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2019-12-31'; // Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = no2Collection.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No NO2 data found for 2018-2019"); print("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for both cities const meanNO2 = no2Collection.mean(); // Calculate NO2 concentrations and valid pixel counts const sjStats = meanNO2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: sanJose, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const laStats = meanNO2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: losAngeles, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const sjResult = sjStats.getInfo(); const laResult = laStats.getInfo(); const sjNO2 = sjResult.NO2_column_number_density_mean; const laNO2 = laResult.NO2_column_number_density_mean; const sjPixels = sjResult.NO2_column_number_density_count; const laPixels = laResult.NO2_column_number_density_count; // Check for valid pixels if (sjPixels === 0 || laPixels === 0) { print(`San Jose pixels: ${sjPixels}, LA pixels: ${laPixels}`); print("C2"); return; } // Validate results if (sjNO2 === null || laNO2 === null || isNaN(sjNO2) || isNaN(laNO2)) { print("Invalid NO2 values detected"); print("C3"); return; } // Print results and determine answer print(`San Jose NO2: ${sjNO2.toFixed(6)} mol/m² (${sjPixels} pixels)`); print(`Los Angeles NO2: ${laNO2.toFixed(6)} mol/m² (${laPixels} pixels)`); print(`Images in collection: ${collectionSize}`); if (sjNO2 > laNO2) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
